fields.description: Use the Flipkart sandbox environment (sandbox-api.flipkart.net) instead of production (api.flipkart.net).
fields.label: Use Sandbox

fields.description: Application ID (client ID) issued when the app was registered with Flipkart.
fields.label: App ID

fields.description: Application Secret (client secret) issued alongside the App ID. Used for Basic Auth when requesting an access token — never sent directly to any other endpoint.
fields.label: App Secret

fields.description: Cached OAuth2 access token from the last successful client_credentials exchange. Read-only — refreshed automatically before it expires.
fields.label: Access Token (cached)

fields.description: The exact HTTPS URL registered with Flipkart for order/return notifications (e.g. https://yourdomain.com/api/method/alaiy_os_connector_flipkart.flipkart.webhooks.receive_notification). Must match byte-for-byte, since it's part of the inbound signature calculation — Flipkart signs each notification with SHA1(timestamp + this URL + method + App Secret), and verification recomputes the same hash.
fields.label: Notification URL

fields.description: Seller identifier assigned by Flipkart — required for the notification enable/disable API, and included in some payloads.
fields.label: Seller ID

fields.description: Not read by any sync logic yet (order/inventory push isn't built) -- placeholder for when it is. Not required so auth-only testing isn't blocked on ERPNext-side setup unrelated to Flipkart.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Default warehouse for stock synced through this connector. Not read by any sync logic yet.
fields.label: Default Warehouse

fields.description: Not read by any sync logic yet.
fields.label: Price List

fields.description: How often to automatically run the pull sync (Flipkart → Alaiy OS).
fields.label: Pull Sync Interval

fields.description: How often to automatically run the push sync (Alaiy OS → Flipkart).
fields.label: Push Sync Interval

fields.description: Master switch for every outbound write to Flipkart: price updates, inventory updates, listing updates, and listing creation (POST /sellers/listings/v3/update/price, /update/inventory, /update, and the bare v3 create endpoint). Off by default -- these are real changes to a live marketplace listing, not a safe-to-retry read. Checked by both the scheduler (sync_jobs.py) and the manual 'Push' trigger (api/sync.py) before anything is sent; is_enabled alone is NOT enough to allow a push.
fields.label: Enable Two-Way Sync (Push)
